segments.an4.207:1.2: kalyāṇañca, kalyāṇena kalyāṇatarañca. Taṃ suṇātha … pe ….
segments.an4.207:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti … pe … micchādiṭṭhiko hoti.
segments.an4.207:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti … pe … attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.
segments.an4.207:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhiko hoti.
segments.an4.207:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti … pe … attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.

lines: Imasmiṃ vagge dasasupi suttesu agāriyappaṭipadā kathitā.
